title: Introduce moeb-conductor: event-driven workflow state machine
description: The autonomous pipeline (release detected → signal_fix → spec → run → PR open → user review → PR merged → tag → new release) requires a durable orchestrator that watches for events and drives moeb skill invocations at each transition. No such component exists. Moeb is correctly scoped as the capability harness; orchestration — watching for events, maintaining workflow state, deciding when to call which skill — is a separate concern that must not be embedded in the harness.
proposed_resolution: Author a new binary (moeb-conductor) as a sibling package in the repository. It must: (1) maintain per-workflow state in SQLite with states RELEASED, SIGNAL_SELECTED, SPEC_AUTHORED, RUN_COMPLETE, PR_OPEN, PR_MERGED, TAGGED; (2) poll the GitHub API for new releases and PR state changes; (3) watch .moeb/events/ for event files written by moeb skills; (4) call moeb over MCP HTTP at each state transition using the correlation IDs threaded through run files and signal catalogue entries; (5) park in PR_OPEN state awaiting human review before proceeding to merge. The conductor is deterministic and non-AI. Depends on: run-file-correlation-chain, signal-fix-history-and-recurrence-tracking, signal-fix-structured-event-emission.
